messages:
Marta: CI red on PR #3421 — typecheck + formatting gate failing. job: https://ci.internal/runs/98765
DevOps-Bot: build 98765 — FAILED — mypy (py3.11) + rustfmt check failed (exit 2)
Marta: failing snippet:
```
packages/engine/src/kvcache.py:47: error: Incompatible types in assignment (expression has type "Optional[str]", variable has type "str")
packages/runtime/src/lib.rs: formatting differs from rustfmt (run `cargo fmt`)
```
Kevin: ping @Marta — did this repro locally or only on CI? any recent toolchain bumps?
Marta: I can repro locally: `./dev/ci/run-typecheck.sh packages/engine` -> same mypy error. pre-commit --all-files also flags rustfmt on runtime crate.
Avi: I bumped mypy-stubgen in #3399 yesterday but that shouldn't change assignment inference. I also updated pyright in the devcontainer a week ago.
Jen: I merged a tiny formatting PR earlier today (format-only) — could be related to rustfmt version mismatch. commit `d9f3a2b` around 05:12 UTC.
Kevin: ok can we bisect quickly? If last green was `c4d2e8a` per CI history, do: `git bisect start HEAD c4d2e8a` then run the typecheck script.
Marta: I can run the bisect but want to avoid breaking other work. If someone else picks it up, pls go ahead.
Kevin: I'll take it unless Marta prefers. quick plan: 1) rerun CI job to rule flake: `./dev/ci/rerun 98765` 2) if reproducible, bisect locally 3) confirm if rust-toolchain pin changed 4) open fix PR or revert offending bump.
DevOps-Bot: Rerun queued by Kevin — job 98765.1 (status: queued)
Marta: thanks — tagging @Jen in case your merge is the culprit
Jen: ack, standing by. if bisect points to my commit I can revert or update rustfmt pin.
Kevin: will update thread with intermediate bisection results. returning to heads-down now. :thumbsup:
